baseline.description: Clean committed solver at 59c5ec6; only the final shared benchmark harness was copied into the baseline before building.

central.scope: Deferred central helper, a<=binary64(.45), b<binary64(.26), q.hi<=.625, z.hi<=.5
central.method: Exact represented normal-polynomial tails on padded cells; recomputed polynomial/Cauchy remainder for shortened Black conversion and all native source-order errors
conditional_inherited_premises: Hash-bound exact normal-shape certificate; its four model cell covers are unchanged, with deleted coefficient tails separately enclosed.
Reviewed pair arithmetic and shortened normal/conversion Horner chains; fixed independent SIMD lanes preserve each retained rounding point.
IEEE RN-even binary64 basic operations and single-rounding FMA, gradual underflow, source order preserved.
central.limits: Conditional continuous helper proof; no whole-domain solver theorem, Lean completion, vendor libm claim, or speed claim.

large.scope: Conditional large-route direct cubic source certificate; exact binary64 normal-price inputs with 10<a<1417 and 0<b<exp(-a/2)

physical_predictor.termination: Exact preserved bracket/gate guards and forced bisections; no proposal accuracy premise

log_iteration.termination: Preserved finite/in-bracket guards, reliable residual signs and forced bisections; no proposal accuracy premise

large.limits: No end-to-end Lean or vendor-libm proof; source hashes and finite tests are not themselves mathematical guarantees. Degree-16 compensated-Mills, finalizer source rounding and target budgets are recomputed, not inferred from old finalizer rho. Adaptive predictor has no universal one-step handoff guarantee; safeguarded stopping is preserved.

seed_controls.scope: 10 deliberate defects, each rejected by the shared bridge and AS1 consumer

reference_provenance.scope: Saved independent roots; current solver outputs are scored afresh. Exact binary64 normal-price open-cap inputs, finite evidence only.

new_predictor_fixture_provenance.scope: Finite exact-input whole-solver accuracy near ideal thresholds and represented quote neighbors; no one-step or whole-domain guarantee

source_differences.change: exact single line-comment edit; no Rust expression changed
test-only suffix after first cfg(test); complete runtime prefix identical
